libs.note: BH-7241: the builder adds the target repo's full-CI label when it opens a PR that needs the full lane. The `full-ci label` block in bin/lib/rb/pr.sh calls fcl_apply right after the PR is open. It runs the repo's own lane classifier (FULL_CI_LANE_SCRIPT) and adds FULL_CI_LABEL unless the lane is `frontend`; a missing or failed classifier labels (the full lane is the safe side). Read per project through lib_env_apply rb-full-ci-label <project>. Doc: docs/notes/2026-10-17-BH-7241-stuck-pr-timers.md.

knobs.note: The label to add. Empty (the default) = off for that project: no classifier run, no label, no log line. Seeded `full-ci` for project-6-os (lib.rb-full-ci-label.project-6-os.full_ci_label).

The lane classifier, relative to the PR's worktree, run as `node <script> --base <merge-base> --head HEAD --github-output <file> --summary /dev/null`; its `lane=` line is the answer. Env only: a path is not a settings row.
The wall-clock bound on one classifier run. Past it the run counts as failed, and the PR is labelled.
